description: Overthinking gets us no where, take control by choosing intention #chooseme #selfmastery #accountability #quantumleap
transcript: I seek intention with everything that I do, in turn I don't overthink anything. When I walk in alignment, when I walk in intention, I clap for myself, I support myself. There is no space within me that has to overthink the process, that has to overanalyze the process because intention leads and guides the way.
